import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    # Fix label variants in Category and Region
    df["Category"] = df["Category"].str.strip().str.title()
    df["Region"] = df["Region"].str.strip().str.title()
    # Drop rows with missing Region
    df = df.dropna(subset=["Region"])
    # Convert Quantity and Price to numeric
    df["Quantity"] = pd.to_numeric(df["Quantity"], errors="coerce")
    df["Price"] = pd.to_numeric(df["Price"], errors="coerce")
    # Drop rows where Quantity or Price are missing or invalid
    df = df.dropna(subset=["Quantity", "Price"])
    # Ensure Quantity is positive integer and within min
    df = df[(df["Quantity"] > 0) & (df["Quantity"].astype(int) == df["Quantity"])]
    # Ensure Price is non-negative
    df = df[df["Price"] >= 0]
    # Compute Revenue if missing (shouldn't be, but just in case)
    df["Revenue"] = df["Quantity"] * df["Price"]
    # Keep id column (Order_ID)
    return df

def answer(df):
    # Group by Category and Region, compute average unit price
    grouped = df.groupby(["Category", "Region"])
    avg_price = grouped["Price"].mean().unstack(fill_value=None)
    # Also compute overall average unit price
    overall_avg = df["Price"].mean()
    result = {
        "all": overall_avg
    }
    for (cat, reg), val in avg_price.items():
        key = f"{cat} | {reg}" if reg is not None else cat
        result[key] = val
    # Drop keys with missing group labels
    result = {k: v for k, v in result.items() if k != "" and pd.notnull(k)}
    return result
